items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: One Flow Production Tracking status as a coloured badge, using the site's own bg_color and icon.
items.docs: Pass the resolved Status row for colour and icon, or just a field schema for the label. An unknown code renders as itself in a muted badge.

items.name: entity-chip
items.title: Entity Chip
items.description: A linked Flow Production Tracking row as a chip, with a per-type glyph, optional thumbnail and a remove control.
items.docs: Takes an EntityRef exactly as an entity field returns it. With no name it falls back to `Type #id`.

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: A row's thumbnail, with aspect ratio, an explicit no-image placeholder and a play overlay.
items.docs: The value of an image field is the only state marker there is: null, still transcoding, or ready. All three render.

items.name: user-avatar
items.title: User Avatar
items.description: A person as a round avatar, with an initials fallback, inactive styling and an API-user badge.
items.docs: Initials come from core's initialsOf so both frameworks derive them identically.

items.name: field-value
items.title: Field Value
items.description: Any Flow Production Tracking attribute value, rendered for display by its data type.
items.docs: Installs EntityChip, StatusBadge and Thumbnail alongside it.

items.name: entity-type-picker
items.title: Entity Type Picker
items.description: One entity type of a Flow Production Tracking site, or several, as a searchable combobox.
items.docs: Takes a SchemaService. `allow` and `deny` narrow the derived options, so changing them re-filters with no second call.

items.name: field-picker
items.title: Field Picker
items.description: One field of an entity type as a searchable combobox, descending through linked types into a dotted path.
items.docs: Emits ShotGrid's dotted path. Only single entity fields are descended into; a path through a multi-entity field reads back nothing.

items.name: column-picker
items.title: Column Picker
items.description: An ordered list of field paths, built with the field picker, reordered by drag or keyboard.
items.docs: Installs FieldPicker alongside it. Paths already chosen are fed back as exclusions, so a column cannot be added twice.
